quarterly_data.signal: NextEra Energy's 10-K: in 2025 NEER added approximately 1,604 MW of new wind generating capacity, 2,859 MW of solar generating capacity and 1,799 MW of battery storage capacity and increased its backlog of contracted development projects. The estimated capital expenditures in Note 15 - Commitments (described as estimated capital expenditures in 2026 through 2030) include new wind projects and repowering of existing wind projects totaling approximately 3,575 MW, new solar projects (including solar plus battery storage) totaling approximately 11,435 MW and primarily battery storage projects totaling approximately 4,616 MW, each with related transmission.
quarterly_data.figure: 2025 additions: 1,604 MW wind, 2,859 MW solar, 1,799 MW battery storage; 2026-2030 capex estimates include ~3,575 MW wind, ~11,435 MW solar, ~4,616 MW battery storage

quarterly_data.signal: As of December 31, 2025, NEER has entered into contracts primarily for the purchase of wind turbines, wind towers, solar modules, batteries and transmission equipment and related construction and development activities, and for the supply of uranium and the conversion, enrichment and fabrication of nuclear fuel, with expiration dates through 2033; approximately $8.7 billion of related commitments are included in the estimated capital expenditures. 2025 capital expenditures, independent power and other investments and nuclear fuel purchases totaled $24,606 million: FPL $8,935 million (new generation $2,915 million; transmission and distribution $4,498 million) and NEER $15,669 million (solar including solar plus battery storage $6,975 million; wind $3,325 million; other clean energy $3,295 million).
quarterly_data.figure: ~$8.7 billion NEER commitments for equipment, related construction and nuclear fuel (through 2033); 2025 capex $24,606 million (FPL $8,935 million, NEER $15,669 million)
